title: Global Securities Watchdog Warns of Quantum Computing Threat to Blockchains and Finance
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Global Securities Watchdog Warns of Quantum Computing Threat to Blockchains and Finance The global securities regulators’ body says quantum computers could break today’s cryptography, and that moving blockchains to quantum-resistant security will be especially hard. This post Global Securities Watchdog Warns of Quantum Computing Threat to Blockchains and Finance first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
